bio.text: Eliza Hamrick, a Democrat, has represented District 61 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Hamrick holds an undergraduate degree from the University of Arizona and previously worked as an educator in the Cherry Creek School District.
